# Yorick Talvwick

Yorick Talvwick is currently a Safety Systems Analyst at Umbaly Cloud, a leading developer of autonomous rebar tying robotics that enhance construction speed and consistency. In this role, Yorick focuses on designing AI-driven hazard detection systems to improve on-site safety monitoring across complex construction environments.

Before joining Umbaly Cloud in 2022, Yorick spent seven years at UrbanBuild Group, where he led the implementation of predictive safety alert solutions that reduced on-site incidents by 18%. His work at UrbanBuild included the development of the “Sentinel Watch” project—an AI module that leveraged real-time sensor data to forecast potential hazards hours in advance, allowing proactive intervention.

Yorick specializes in integrating machine learning algorithms with field hardware to create adaptive, context-aware safety systems. His expertise spans computer vision, sensor fusion, and anomaly detection tailored to dynamic construction settings. He is known for a collaborative approach, frequently working alongside robotics engineers, field safety officers, and data scientists to refine system accuracy and usability.

Notable recent projects at Umbaly include “IronEye,” a drone-based hazard reconnaissance initiative that complements the rebar tying robots by providing aerial site risk assessments. Yorick’s analytical rigor and hands-on field testing underpin the ongoing enhancement of Umbaly Cloud’s autonomous safety capabilities.
